summary.text: Jose Castaneda is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 40 (home city listed as Minot), serving since 2025 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Castaneda lists an occupation of Air Med Pilot.
It lists education as BS, Electrical Engineer, US Air Force Academy; MS, Aeronautics, Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University.
It also lists Retired Lt. Col. USAF B-52 Pilot.
Family is listed as: Married (Feliciana); 8 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Castaneda's standing committee assignments as State and Local Government (vice chair) and Judiciary.
